headline: On November 15, 2006: Al Jazeera English launches worldwide
captionCards: First global English-language news channel headquartered in the Middle East
Redefined global news by bringing Middle Eastern perspectives to international audiences
instagramCaption:
Al Jazeera English goes global on November 15, 2006.

The first global English-language news channel based in the Middle East begins broadcasting.
It is part of Al Jazeera Media Network, partially funded by Qatar’s government.
Its launch marked a shift in international news coverage from Western hubs to the Middle East.
Today, it remains a major alternative voice in global media.
